subject: delay weight
bytes: fused multiply add fma(vty, 10000, -4) / 20, fma(vty, 10000, -3) / 12, fma(vty, 10000, -1.5) * 0.125: linear in vty; slot 0x576f6e0 resolves to vfmadd213sd

subject: curve selector
reference lead: ActionDelayerMode, delay_curve_byte 1 for Disabled and Enabled
bytes: the byte is the chain byte passed in by the wrapper; below 2 every kind takes the default curve, 2 and above 3 have separate kind lists

subject: infinite weight
bytes: a positive infinity skips the clamp and the delay stays infinite; NaN and negative infinity panic

subject: queue shape
bytes: BTreeMap keyed by the 12-byte due time, value Vec of 0x148-byte records

subject: due time
reference lead: integer now plus ceil(delay * scale) seconds
bytes: now + f64 seconds through 0x1459ca0, no ceil, nanosecond resolution

subject: max zero
bytes: n_total >= max refuses, so max 0 refuses every delayed action

subject: per user cap
bytes: count > 99 refuses with tag 0x13b; the row is created first

subject: release bound
bytes: split at now, keys strictly below now leave, a key equal to now stays

subject: delayer_mode
bytes: two tags: 0 Enabled, 1 PerAsset with a map of action id to window width; the host reads it only for the odd window gate

subject: disabled mode
reference lead: Disabled error when the mode is off
bytes: no mode test on this path: a delay <= 0 runs now, otherwise it queues

subject: max votes
bytes: word 79 refuses on chain byte 3, then 100 <= x <= 300000
